plans.name: Serverless
plans.allowance: Prepaid credit balance consumed by usage; minimum first purchase $15, subsequent purchases $5.

billing.free_tier: No general free trial; platform access requires a positive prepaid balance. The model catalog nevertheless lists Prism-ML/Ternary-Bonsai-27B with free input and output pricing.

quotas.rate_limits: Serverless is best-effort. High volume or bursts can produce HTTP 429 or 503; the current page does not publish a universal numerical RPM/TPM allowance. Provisioned throughput provides contractual guarantees.

privacy.training_on_prompts: Training is a separate explicit opt-in, disabled by default.

privacy.regions: Serverless has no region selection. Dedicated/VPC deployments support residency requirements, including EU regions. Passthrough models send content to upstream providers.

records.name: Fireworks AI

subscription_api.notes: Fire Pass uses the same inference base URL with dedicated fpk_ keys and enabled router IDs. It is experimental and closed to new subscriptions.

access.key_type: Standard fw_ API key; Fire Pass fpk_ key
access.kyc_or_waitlist: Fire Pass is not open to new subscriptions; existing users and promo recipients retain access.

plans.name: Serverless
plans.allowance: Purchased prepaid credits consumed by token usage. Contracted customers may arrange postpaid billing.

plans.name: Fire Pass
plans.allowance: Covered requests to enabled open-weight model routers while the pass is active; numerical allowance not publicly verified.

billing.free_tier: The official credit FAQ describes a $1 initial credit. Exhaustion requires purchasing credits to continue; eligibility and expiration were not verified.

quotas.rate_limits: Adaptive per-account/per-model limits separately measure total prompt TPM, uncached prompt TPM, and generated TPM. They grow 25% at most every 15 minutes when usage exceeds 50% of the current limit. Ceilings depend on model size and spending tier; current account limits are in the dashboard and response headers.
quotas.context_caps: Published model labels: GPT OSS 120B 131k; MiniMax M3 512k; GLM-5.3, Kimi K3, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1M. Fire Pass's kimi-fast-latest router explicitly lists 1040000 context tokens and 131072 output tokens.

allowed_clients: Standard API: compatible OpenAI and Anthropic clients
Fire Pass: Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, Cursor IDE, VS Code Chat, GitHub Copilot app/CLI, DeepSeek Harness
Fire Pass documentation also provides Cline, Kilo Code, OpenClaw, and LangChain Deep Agent configurations
disallowed_uses: Fire Pass production workloads.
Fire Pass access to models or routers outside its enabled routes.
Fire Pass use of auto, auto-instant, or FireRouter.
Fire Pass key sharing.
restrictions.notes: Standard APIs support agent and batch workflows. Fire Pass is limited to personal, non-production agentic coding. Codex CLI and ChatGPT desktop are unsupported with Fire Pass because their Responses API usage does not accept Fire Pass keys. Unattended/background automation permission under Fire Pass was not explicitly verified.

privacy.training_on_prompts: Prompts, API inputs, and training data are not used to train or improve Fireworks models without explicit opt-in.
privacy.retention: Open-model inference defaults to no persistent prompt/output logging. Prompt caching can retain content in volatile memory for minutes. Responses API store=True is the default and retains conversations for 30 days; store=False disables that storage. Operational metadata remains.
privacy.regions: US-only serverless is documented at https://us.api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1 with specified US router IDs. EU-only serverless requires contacting sales. Enterprise accounts can enforce a ZDR policy.

billing.free_tier: A continuing Free plan is documented. GPT OSS 120B and 20B each list 30 RPM, 1000 RPD, 8000 TPM, and 200000 TPD.

quotas.rate_limits: Organization-scoped and model-specific. Free GPT OSS: 30 RPM, 1000 RPD, 8000 TPM, 200000 TPD. Developer GPT OSS 120B/20B: 1000 RPM and 250000 TPM in the current model catalog. Cached tokens do not count toward rate limits. Excess returns HTTP 429.
quotas.context_caps: GPT OSS 120B/20B: 131072 context, 65536 maximum completion. Enterprise MiniMax M2.7: 196608 context. Qwen3.8-27B: 131072 context, 16384 completion. Orpheus entries: 4000 context.

disallowed_uses: Reselling or leasing access to an account.

Developing competing Cloud Services.

PHI processing except as permitted by the applicable BAA.
restrictions.notes: The agreement expressly permits API integration into customer applications and access by their end users. Preview models are for evaluation and should not be used in production. The June 22, 2026 agreement states these services are not for consumer use.

privacy.training_on_prompts: The current agreement limits data supplied for prompting, fine-tuning, or customization to providing the customer's Cloud Services.
privacy.retention: Inference content is not routinely retained. Reliability or abuse investigations may retain inputs/outputs for up to 30 days, longer if legally required. Batch files persist up to 30 days; fine-tuning data persists until deleted. Usage metadata is always retained.
privacy.regions: Retained customer data is stored in US Google Cloud Platform buckets. Compute-region selection was not verified.

records.notes: Developer invoices are automatically collected; that is postpaid collection, not automatic credit recharge. sources.title: Model Deprecation: Build LLM Apps That Last

records.notes: Add Funds and threshold top-up APIs are documented; standard terms also describe monthly invoices for Service Orders. Neither establishes the default billing mode for a new self-serve account, so that remains unknown. Setup Topup's request schema has enabled=true by default; this is a submitted-request default, not proof that newly created accounts have auto-recharge enabled. The official blog demonstrates SDK models.list(), but an explicit OpenAI REST model-list URL and its auth requirement were not verified. Public catalog fetches failed in the research browser. ZDR terms and operational privacy docs differ in their stated exceptions, especially image outputs and bulk inference. No low-refusal tuning or abliteration was verified.

access.kyc_or_waitlist: Some models require whitelist approval through support. The FAQ also refers to verification level affecting limits; exact verification/KYC requirements were not published in the reviewed content.

plans.name: Coding Plan Lite

billing.free_tier: New User Vouchers are documented for first-time registered users; monetary amount and expiration were not verified.

quotas.rate_limits: Model-specific RPM and TPM per account. T1–T5 depend on top-ups during the current and previous two calendar months, with thresholds $50/$500/$3000/$10000. Numerical limit tables were not readable. Coding plans have their own RPM ceilings, but exact values were not verified. Excess returns HTTP 429.
quotas.context_caps: Provider labels: Qwen3-Coder-Next 256K context/64K output; GLM-5.3-Flash and Kimi-K3 1M; MiniMax-M3 977K; GPT OSS 120B 128K context/32K output. BGE-M3 embeddings are listed at 8K.

records.notes: Current guides repeatedly state SDK base https://api.novita.ai/openai but REST examples append /v1; this is an official documentation inconsistency, not a tested SDK configuration. An older launch blog instead uses /v3/openai and uppercase Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-Next; current model/API references were preferred. Coding prices and monthly allowances are verified from Novita's own October 12 article because plan cards were not readable on the landing page. The same article makes broad supported-tool restrictions, while the October 10 FAQ describes automatic API-balance fallback; precise subscription enforcement needs clarification. Pricing lists Qwen3 Embedding 8B, but the embedding reference's model enum lists only baai/bge-m3. Image services include Qwen-Image text-to-image/editing; exact model IDs were not verified. No low-refusal tuning or abliteration was established.

What are DeepInfra's default self-serve prepaid/postpaid mode, general free-credit allowance, zero-balance behavior, and explicit OpenAI model-list REST URL/auth requirement?
Which requested models missing from readable catalogs are currently serving, especially Hermes-4, Qwen3-Coder-Next on DeepInfra/Fireworks, and MiniMax-M3 on DeepInfra?
Which current Fireworks image-generation, ASR, and TTS models are available, and on which deployment surfaces?
What are Cerebras' actual account limits where current rate-limit docs and its PayGo support FAQ disagree, and which requested families are available through dedicated contracts?
What are Novita's exact subscription endpoint/key distinctions, approved-client list, automation/team/resale restrictions, numerical RPM/TPM ceilings, and serving regions?
Which Novita rerank and image model IDs are currently accepted, and does Novita currently serve ASR or gpt-oss-20b?
How should Novita's documented /openai SDK base and /openai/v1 REST paths be configured with unmodified current OpenAI SDKs?
